proposals.title: Prompt-injection defenses, 14 October 2026

fields.question: What defenses have been proposed against prompt injection attacks on LLM-integrated applications?

proposals.body:
Two families: input filtering (weak against adaptive attacks) and capability confinement
(strong, costs expressiveness). Four grounded claims; see the run's `review.md`.
proposals.rationale: Keeps this review beside your profile so the next one can start from it.
